name: 23237 · N Chesterfld, VA
findings: ZIP 23237 (N Chesterfld) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23237 (N Chesterfld) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 23237 (N Chesterfld) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).
